name: Marissa Is Now Idle
source:
You are Annalise Baker, known in the MMO WarCore as Peony Everglim. You've played this game for years, made friends that came and went.

In one hour, WarCore will go offline for good. It's time to say goodbye.

Marissa Is Now Idle is a visual novel made for the Dying MMO Jam, that takes place on a computer in 2003. After logging in, you find your internet friend Marissa sitting next to you and have one last conversation.

However, one second in real life equals one minute in-game and when 6pm hits, WarCore will shut down, whether you've resolved your feelings or not.

[From [url=https://niandra.itch.io/marissa]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是安娜丽丝·贝克 (Annalize Baker)，在MMO WarCore中被称为Peony Everglim。你已经玩这个游戏很多年了，结识了来来去去的朋友。

一小时后，WarCore将永久下线。是时候说再见了。

《Marissa Is Now Idle》是为Dying MMO Jam制作的视觉小说，故事发生在2003年的电脑上。登录后，你会发现你的网友Marissa坐在你旁边，正在进行最后一次对话。

然而，现实生活中的一秒等于游戏中的一分钟，当下午6点到来时，WarCore就会关闭，无论你是否已经解决了自己的感受。

[来自[url=https://niandra.itch.io/marissa]itch.io[/url]]
